description: Amendments of v4's state machines that the owner approved (ODR-V41-08, APR-V41-OWNER-2). v4 is frozen at tag indy-init-requirements-v4.0.0 and its files are never edited: requirements-compiler v41 applies each transition over the frozen machines when it compiles state-machine-contracts.json. Check X12 requires each transition and accepted entry to name a state-machine-amendment request and its operator approval, sources that are baseline requirements, and a fit with its machine (known states and events, deterministic guards, Saved entered only by a confirmation); the offline suite checks that the owner's selected option adds exactly these transitions. No state or event is added. Engine.Update (src/Causa.App/Engine.fs, ui) steps MutationSent in the same update that turns the mutation request into HostEffect.Http (IF41-SAVE, IF41-APP); because T-S61 changes nothing, a missing MutationSent changes no outcome, and no test beyond T-S61's state-machine test requires it.

transitions.guard: current: its RequestId is the session's Outstanding request, which awaits MutationAnswer
effects: none: the state, the base head, Outstanding (RequestId, MutationAnswer) and the unsaved changes are unchanged; the event confirms that the outstanding createCommitOnBranch was handed to the host

accepted.note: SM-LOAD keeps no transport-failure event: a provider refusal, a transport failure or a lost answer during a load is LoadRejected carrying LoadFailure.ProviderFailed (IF41-SAVE), as the owner accepted. No transition is added.
